Check the GlitchTip project for receipt.

If enabled, 8bercue sends only the error class and application code location to GlitchTip. Raw exception messages, logs, eUICC details, and personal identifiers are not uploaded. The receiving service may process your connection IP. This setting is off by default.
What happened? What did you expect?
Describe the issue. A short, allowlisted device summary will be included. Do not paste activation codes, EID or personal identifiers.
Add a description to report the problem.
This report contains only the following device and failure details. It does not include EID, activation codes, profiles, APDU, logs or a device ID.\n\n
\nSending to GlitchTip also exposes network connection metadata to that provider.
You can email support or save a diagnostic ZIP.
The report was handed to GlitchTip for delivery. This does not confirm it was indexed in the dashboard.
Try the support email option or export a diagnostic ZIP.
The ZIP includes only allowlisted app and device information. It excludes card IDs, profiles, activation codes, APDU, logcat and private files. Review it before sharing.
Inspect the ZIP before sharing it with support.
